meaning:
προ-δότης, -ου, ὁ
(προδίδωμι) [in LXX: 2Ma.5:15 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:22, 3Ma.3:24 * ;]
a betrayer, traitor: Luk.6:16, Act.7:52, 2Ti.3:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and…
traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
